description: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs lines 409-416: if chain[0] has BasicConstraints cA=TRUE, LeafIsCA is returned. If a caller passes a 1-cert chain where chain[0] is a self-signed root certificate (subject == issuer, cA=TRUE) that also appears in anchors[], the chain would be rejected with LeafIsCA rather than succeeding. This is an edge case but is a valid PKI configuration (direct-trust of a CA cert without a separate leaf). The check's intent is to reject CA certs acting as end-entity certs; it should not fire when chain[0] is also a trust anchor. Current behavior is arguably correct for the stated 'simple' contract but the rustdoc for LeafIsCA does not mention this edge case.
title: LeafIsCA check fires on self-signed root used directly as chain[0]
